name: 01 igualdad con indice
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status = 'raro'

name: 02 igualdad sin indice
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total = 10.5

name: 03 rango fechas
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-02' AND created_at < '2026-01-03'

raw.Index Cond: ((created_at >= '2026-01-02 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone) AND (created_at < '2026-01-03 00:00:00'::timestamp without time zone))

scans.predicate: ((ql_pt_orders.created_at >= CAST($1 AS TIMESTAMPTZ)) AND (ql_pt_orders.created_at < CAST($2 AS TIMESTAMPTZ)))

name: 04 BETWEEN
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total BETWEEN 10 AND 20

name: 05 IN lista
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status IN ('raro', 'pendiente')

name: 06 distinto
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status <> 'entregado'

name: 07 OR
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status = 'raro' OR total > 99

name: 08 IS NULL
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE note IS NULL

name: 09 LIKE prefijo
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE note LIKE 'nota1%'

name: 10 LIKE sufijo
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE note LIKE '%99'

name: 11 funcion LOWER
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_customers WHERE LOWER(email) = 'user5@x.com'

name: 12 aritmetica
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total + 0 = 10

name: 13 DATE()
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE DATE(created_at) = '2026-01-02'

name: 14 CAST explicito
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE CAST(code AS INTEGER) = 5

name: 15 char contra numero (solo MySQL)
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE code = 5

name: 16 int contra decimal
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE customer_id = 5.0

name: 17 indice + funcion
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status = 'raro' AND LOWER(note) = 'nota100'

name: 18 indice + otra columna
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND total > 50

name: 19 JOIN con filtros
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ql_pt_orders o JOIN ql_pt_customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.region = 3 AND o.status = 'raro'

name: 20 IN subconsulta
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM ql_pt_customers WHERE region = 3)

name: 21 EXISTS correlacionado
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ql_pt_orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ql_pt_customers c WHERE c.id = o.customer_id AND LOWER(c.email) LIKE 'user1%')

name: 22 subconsulta escalar
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ql_pt_orders o WHERE o.customer_id = (SELECT MIN(c.id) FROM ql_pt_customers c WHERE LOWER(c.name) = 'name7')

scans.predicate: (o.customer_id = (SELECT MIN(c.id) FROM ql_pt_customers AS c WHERE (LOWER(c.name) = $1)))

name: 23 CTE
sql: WITH r AS (SELECT id FROM ql_pt_customers WHERE region = 3) SELECT o.id FROM ql_pt_orders o JOIN r ON r.id = o.customer_id

name: 24 tabla derivada
sql: SELECT t.id FROM (SELECT id, total FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > 50) t WHERE t.id < 1000

name: 25 GROUP BY HAVING
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > 50 GROUP BY status HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

name: 26 ORDER BY LIMIT
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > 50 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

name: 27 CASE en WHERE
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE CASE WHEN status = 'raro' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END = 1

name: 28 COALESCE
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE COALESCE(note, '') = ''

name: 29 columna contra columna
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > id

name: 30 NOT
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE NOT (status = 'raro')

name: 31 IN un valor
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE id IN (5)

name: 32 decimal negativo
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > -5.5

name: 33 texto con comilla
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_customers WHERE name = 'O''Brien'

name: 34 LEFT JOIN anti-join
sql: SELECT c.id FROM ql_pt_customers c LEFT JOIN ql_pt_orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL

name: 35 UNION
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status = 'raro' UNION SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE total > 99

name: 36 self join
sql: SELECT a.id FROM ql_pt_orders a JOIN ql_pt_orders b ON b.id = a.id + 1 WHERE a.status = 'raro'

name: 37 concatenacion
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_customers WHERE name || 'x' = 'name5x'

name: 38 intervalo
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'

name: 39 funcion en el ON
sql: SELECT o.id FROM ql_pt_orders o JOIN ql_pt_customers c ON LOWER(c.email) = LOWER(o.note) WHERE o.status = 'raro'

name: 40 OR con funcion
sql: SELECT id FROM ql_pt_orders WHERE status = 'raro' OR LOWER(note) = 'nota5'
